verdict.rationale: The evidence pack shows no Kimi feature for grouping related chats and files into a project or space with shared context and instructions. The nearby items are different features. API Platform 'projects' (kimi-key-hierarchy) handle budgets, keys and rate limits. Kimi Code Desktop opens a local code folder for a coding agent. The help-center mention of 'memory' and per-conversation file upload do not amount to a shared project workspace.

support.subject: As a knowledge-worker, I can organize related chats and files into a project or space that shares context and instructions
